sources.summary: Danish architect Nikolaj Mentze has overhauled the interior of Cobe's architecture studio in Copenhagen by adding a bookshop dedicated to publications on the built environment. The bookshop, which opened during the annual festival 3 Days of Design earlier this month, features books on architecture, urbanism, landscape and design displayed on bespoke aluminium shelving and wooden display The post Nikolaj Mentze fits out Cobe's Copenhagen studio with architecture bookshop appeared first on Dezeen .
